derivation: from H6031 (עָנָה), in the sense of depression or tilling;

occurrences.text: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow.
The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
